listing.name: Animated Vanilla Portraits
listing.summary: Animate all 225 vanilla portraits with comm static. Requires VideoLib : https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=34134
listing.aiSummary: Adds animated versions of all 225 vanilla portraits with varying comm noise effects, tailored to different factions.

description:
Animated Vanilla Portraits

Requires VideoLib

Animates all 225 vanilla portraits with various comm noise. Different factions gets different effects.

Spoiler

This process is rather RAM intensive. Bumping it up to 8GB using TriOS is recommended.

Performance has been drastically increased thanks to the new update to VideoLib. Bumping up the RAM is no longer necessary. Make sure to update to v0.1.1!

Currently if you enable the "run-as-fast-as-possible mode" onAtStart from the SpeedUp mod, the portraits will play super fast in the portrait selection screen.

If you experience any other issues please let me know.

[close]

Download here

aiDescription: Adds animated versions of all 225 vanilla portraits with various comm noise effects, with different animations applied per faction. The animations are designed to enhance visual feedback during dialogue and selection screens. Performance has been improved with updated VideoLib support, and the mod now runs efficiently without requiring increased RAM.
